inactive.exit_condition: A valid req bind operation binds one human-locked REQ.

planning.description: PM/Architect produces or revises the formal planning phases design, contracts and tasks. The phase cursor is authoritative; artifact inspection is reserved for explicit legacy reconciliation.
planning.entry_condition: The locked baseline is captured (TR-001) or specification rework is required (TR-004/013/023).
planning.exit_condition: At least one CONTRACTS-*.md has status=locked AND at least one TASK-*.md has status=complete (TR-002).

document_verification.description: Independent Document Verifiers inspect reviewed contracts and candidate tasks together.
document_verification.entry_condition: Planning output is complete and internally reviewed.
document_verification.exit_condition: Documents pass, require rework, or require a human REQ change.

building.description: Builders read back, activate and implement the atomically locked contract/task batch.
building.entry_condition: DOCUMENT_PASS locks exact contract and task versions.
building.exit_condition: Builder reports are complete or specification rework is required.

verification.description: One frozen baseline, one ReviewPlan with an exact required Claim set, 1..N DV/QA/E2E reviewer Assignments, one Canonical ReviewResult per Assignment, and a machine-computed CleanRound or sealed ObservationBatch.
verification.entry_condition: S6 builder results are integrated and consumed (or S9 targeted re-verification passed) and a new review round is open.
verification.exit_condition: The machine CleanRound passes (TR-009), a sealed ObservationBatch hands the exact Finding set to S8 (TR-008), or the Loop pauses on a verdict (TR-010/TR-011).

bug_resolution.description: S8 consumes sealed S7 Findings into InvestigationCases, derives causal models and approved RepairContracts; S9 repairs only from an approved RepairContract. Canonical BUGs are compatibility projections, not authorities.
bug_resolution.entry_condition: A sealed S7 ObservationBatch with an exact immutable Finding set exists, or a human release decision routes a finding into S8.
bug_resolution.exit_condition: The approved RepairContract completes targeted re-verification and hands back to S7, or the InvestigationCase is routed to specification, REQ, duplicate, no-change, or further investigation.

acceptance.description: ACC is assembled from the locked baseline and one valid clean round.
acceptance.entry_condition: All required same-round evidence passes and no blocking BUG remains.
acceptance.exit_condition: ACC is complete or evidence requires another full review.

release_audit.description: Release architecture, migration, rollback and operational readiness are audited.
release_audit.exit_condition: Audit is approved or blocking findings pause the Loop.

paused.description: Automation is suspended with an exact state, phase and entity checkpoint.
paused.entry_condition: Human decision, REQ change, high-risk action, repair limit or runtime integrity requires a pause.
paused.exit_condition: Human action resumes the checkpoint, reinitializes a changed baseline, or aborts the Loop.

awaiting_human_release.description: Automation stops at the human release gateway; only constrained human decision events may route S11.
awaiting_human_release.entry_condition: ACC and release architecture audit are approved.
awaiting_human_release.exit_condition: A human-authorized decision event routes to release_authorized, paused, bug_resolution, acceptance, release_audit, or aborted.

release_authorized.description: An external human release owner authorized the release handoff; the Harness performs no release side effect.
release_authorized.entry_condition: TR-025 records a current human release decision.

aborted.description: A human terminated the Loop without release.

design.description: Design phase. The Architect completes the architecture package and any required UI design package for the bound REQ.
design.entry_condition: TR-001 binds a locked REQ, or a rework transition returns the Loop from DV / building / bug_resolution / paused.
design.exit_condition: GATE-PLANNING-DESIGN-COMPLETE is satisfied and PTR-PLAN-01 is committed.

contracts.description: Contracts phase. The Contractor publishes the locked BE/SYNC/FE contract set with complete REQ and architecture traceability.
contracts.exit_condition: GATE-PLANNING-CONTRACTS-COMPLETE is satisfied and PTR-PLAN-02 is committed.

tasks.description: Tasks phase. The Task Planner publishes a complete executable TASK batch and dependency DAG.
tasks.exit_condition: GATE-PLANNING-TASKS-COMPLETE is satisfied and TR-002 moves the Loop to document_verification.

transitions.description: Advance formal planning from design to contracts after the design quality gate passes. Gate readiness facts: an ARCHITECTURE-*.md whose top status line (状态/Status) declares `locked` plus a valid planning_design JSON envelope (responsibility Architect, conclusion pass — a markdown file as --path yields `evidence:<id>:schema`). Missing tokens `document:design:locked` / `evidence:planning_design_record` mean one of these is absent.

Advance formal planning from contracts to tasks after the contract quality gate passes. Gate readiness facts: a contract declaring `Status: locked` on disk (or an already-registered locked contract in runtime documents[]) plus valid planning_contract evidence — the missing token `document:contract:locked` means neither was found; flip the contract's top status line（状态/Status）to locked.

planned.description: A review round is open but no ReviewPlan is registered yet.
planned.entry_condition: TR-006/TR-012/TR-016 opened a new review round.
planned.exit_condition: A schema-valid ReviewPlan with an exactly-partitioned required Claim set is registered via runtime review-plan.

running.description: The ReviewPlan is registered; static DV/QA Claims and (after they settle) behavior E2E Claims are dispatched and consumed.
running.entry_condition: ReviewPlan registered for the current round.
running.exit_condition: Every required Claim has a consumed disposition; a finding flips the round to cannot_clean.

cannot_clean.description: At least one confirmed Finding exists; the clean path is closed but ordinary safe discovery continues.
cannot_clean.entry_condition: A consumed ReviewResult carried a Finding.
cannot_clean.exit_condition: The remaining required Claims complete (discovery_draining) or a P0 finding seals the batch immediately.

discovery_draining.description: The remaining required Claims are being completed after a confirmed ordinary finding (drain_policy=complete_required_claims).
discovery_draining.entry_condition: cannot_clean with undispositioned required Claims still being consumed.
discovery_draining.exit_condition: The final required Claim disposition lands and the ObservationBatch seals.

observation_sealed.description: The final required Claim set is dispositioned and the ObservationBatch carries the exact Finding set for S8.
observation_sealed.exit_condition: TR-008 hands the batch to bug_resolution.

clean.description: Every applicable Claim was consumed without findings; the machine CleanRound snapshot is registered.
clean.entry_condition: Round consumer computed the CleanRound over the exact Claim set.
clean.exit_condition: TR-009 promotes the clean round into acceptance.

investigation.description: Investigators consume S7 encounter/raw evidence, form competing hypotheses and answer independent discriminator questions. Reproduction is an exception for missing or contradictory evidence, not an intake requirement.
investigation.entry_condition: TR-008 or a human defect decision has opened an InvestigationCase with an exact source Finding set and a frozen baseline.
investigation.exit_condition: The Case has a supported causal model, or an explicit route to investigate_more, specification rework, REQ decision, duplicate, or no-change.

bug_report_review.description: Legacy compatibility projection only. New S8 paths do not enter this phase and do not use canonical BUG acceptance as their authority. Existing BUG records are projections of an InvestigationCase/RepairContract and must be mapped back to those artifacts before repair.
bug_report_review.entry_condition: An older implementation has already materialized a BUG projection that must be reconciled into an InvestigationCase.
bug_report_review.exit_condition: The projection is mapped to a Case and, when repair is requested, an approved RepairContract exists; otherwise the projection returns to investigation for Case reconciliation.

repair_readback.description: S9 Repair Builders read the approved RepairContract and submit structured understanding. A compatibility BUG projection may be read for legacy context but cannot authorize repair.
repair_readback.entry_condition: An approved RepairContract is durably referenced and handed off from S8.
repair_readback.exit_condition: Understanding and phase-two activation are approved against the RepairContract.

planning.description: S9 Repair Builders bind each RepairUnit to an explicit Assignment/assertion map and submit an immutable PlanReport with proposed scope and a failing pre-fix check; product writes remain denied.
planning.entry_condition: A RepairSession and RepairPlan are created from the approved RepairContract.
planning.exit_condition: Every required Assignment has a bound PlanReport.

reproducing.description: The Runtime and PreToolUse Hook hold the product first-write barrier while the builder confirms the original failure and records red pre-fix evidence.
reproducing.entry_condition: A PlanReport is accepted for the current RepairPlan and Assignment.
reproducing.exit_condition: The explicit S9 execution-begin checkpoint is committed.

fixing.description: Activated repair Builders implement within the approved RepairContract scope and immutable Assignment/path boundary; every Assignment must report exact units before impact reconciliation.
fixing.entry_condition: Repair activation is recorded and an approved RepairContract is current.
fixing.exit_condition: Fix reports, changed paths and validation evidence exist for the Contract.

targeted_reverification.description: The original Finding responsibility checks the RepairContract symptom, invariant and detection-gap assertions.
targeted_reverification.entry_condition: Repair evidence exists, affected PASS evidence is invalidated, and the approved RepairContract is current.
targeted_reverification.exit_condition: Targeted checks pass or return to investigation.

ready_for_full_review.description: A terminal handoff checkpoint inside S9: all RepairContract assertions pass and no further S9 work may start; the only successor is TR-012 into a complete Delivery + QA + E2E Browser round.
ready_for_full_review.entry_condition: All source Findings covered by the approved RepairContract pass targeted re-verification.
ready_for_full_review.exit_condition: TR-012 returns the top-level Loop to verification.delivery.

transitions.description: S9 enters planning with a dispatchable Assignment set; no implementation write is authorized yet.
Builders report their intended repair and failing pre-fix signal before execution.
Only the explicit execution checkpoint releases implementation writes.

Legacy compatibility transition only. If an older implementation emits bug_drafts_ready, the resulting BUG records are projections that must be reconciled into an InvestigationCase; new paths keep the Case status in its artifact and do not create a second runtime phase machine.
Legacy compatibility projection only. A canonical BUG acceptance event cannot authorize S9 unless an approved RepairContract is already present; new paths do not enter bug_report_review.
Legacy compatibility projection only. Rejected BUG projections return to the InvestigationCase rather than creating another per-Finding BUG draft.

Legacy compatibility projection only. The current S8 main path is `runtime investigation contract approve`, which writes immutable approved Case/Contract revisions, pins their hashes, and enters S9 repair_readback directly; it does not invoke this PTR-BUG-08 catalog transition. No canonical BUG acceptance is required or sufficient.

Legacy compatibility projection only. Current S9 dispatch uses `runtime repair dispatch` for each RepairAssignment, then the explicit `runtime repair execution begin` checkpoint releases implementation writes.
Every repair invalidates affected historical PASS evidence before recheck.
A targeted pass never substitutes for the full review round; it records the S9-to-S7 handoff checkpoint.

After an environmental or authority blocker is resolved, reopen the existing targeted verification checkpoint; runtime hard-checks status=blocked, failure_route=blocked, and a non-empty resolution reason. A new independent TargetedReverification is still required, and this transition never authorizes a repair or a pass.
Failed repair verification returns to the same InvestigationCase for causal reassessment; it does not create a new BUG draft unless the causal model genuinely differs.
Start exactly one Loop for the named locked REQ.

Planning completes when contracts are locked and the TASK batch is fully complete on disk (planning_complete), with clause coverage, DAG acyclicity, and closing contracts verified (tasks_checked). Gate readiness facts: a TASK declaring `Status: complete` on disk (or a registered complete task) plus valid planning_task evidence — the missing token `document:task:complete` means neither was found. On commit, locked contracts and complete tasks are registered into documents[].
Lock only the exact contract and task versions jointly verified.
Non-REQ document findings return to planning.design for reworking the failing artifacts.
REQ changes always return control to the human.

Start a complete review round after every TASK in the TR-003 exact execution batch has a Builder Result with passing checks, no unapproved scope deviations, and a verified integration checkpoint. S7 verification planning starts from the real integrated diff at its own entry; the building stage no longer demands S7 team-manifest evidence it cannot legitimately produce.
Non-REQ execution conflicts return through planning and document verification.

A sealed ObservationBatch carries the exact immutable Finding set (with encounters, wall actions and evidence refs) into the S8 Runtime cursor. TR-008 records the cursor handoff; the next mandatory S8 verb is `runtime investigation ingest`, which creates the InvestigationCase after exact-set/hash/baseline validation. S8 consumes the facts and does not re-reproduce symptoms by default. No per-Finding BUG draft is created; any legacy BUG draft is only a compatibility projection of the Case.

Acceptance requires the machine CleanRound: every required Claim of the current ReviewPlan has a consumed pass Result, no current-round Finding exists, and the clean-round snapshot is recomputed by the clean_round_valid guard at promotion time.

A ReviewResult verdict of req_change_required pauses the loop for a human REQ decision. The verdict transaction (runtime review-result submit) already created the single authoritative pause checkpoint; this transition only moves the cursor.

A ReviewResult verdict of release_blocked pauses the loop for a human release decision. The verdict transaction (runtime review-result submit) already created the single authoritative pause checkpoint; this transition only moves the cursor.
Only the ready_for_full_review handoff checkpoint for an approved RepairContract may enter a complete Delivery + QA + E2E Browser round; targeted re-verification never substitutes for that round.
Repair-driven specification changes return through planning and document verification.
Repair work cannot modify the locked REQ.
Release audit starts only from current ACC and clean-round evidence.
Acceptance discrepancies restart the complete review.
Approved or approved-with-risk audit reaches the human release boundary.
A blocked release audit pauses the Loop.
Resume the exact validated state, phase and entity checkpoint.
A changed locked REQ starts a new planning generation.
Only a human may permanently abort the Loop.

When the InvestigationCase has dispositioned every source Finding as no-change, duplicate, or another non-repair route, and no approved RepairContract remains, the Loop returns to verification for a fresh complete round. The legacy bug_batch_record is only a compatibility projection; spec and REQ changes use TR-023 and TR-024.
Finding-level specification rework (S8) routes back to planning.design for a new TR-002 cycle; complements TR-013 which handles repair-level spec change.
A finding that requires modifying the locked REQ cannot proceed autonomously; the Loop pauses for human amendment. Complements TR-014 which handles repair-level REQ change.
Record human release authorization without performing merge, publication, deployment, or formal release.
Defer the release decision and capture the S11 checkpoint before entering paused.
Route a human defect rejection to bug-resolution investigation with its finding evidence.
Re-enter acceptance and invalidate only prior acceptance and release-audit evidence.
Re-enter release audit and invalidate only prior release-audit evidence.
Record a human release abort without performing any release side effect.

global_transitions.description: A user may pause from any active state.
Any required locked REQ change pauses automation.
Production-data, security, compliance or irreversible actions require human approval.
Configured repair limits never silently close an InvestigationCase or RepairContract; exhaustion pauses the Loop with the current repair evidence.
When the S7 full-review budget is exhausted, a human may return the Runtime to planning for specification or architecture governance instead of authorizing another review round.

forbidden_events.reason: Loop automation cannot change the human-controlled REQ baseline.
Task and Agent Definition scope is mandatory.
Only jointly verified contract and task versions may lock.
Acceptance requires one valid complete review round.
Release audit requires complete ACC evidence.
Squash merge to master/main is human-controlled.
Formal release is outside Loop automation.
Automation stops at awaiting_human_release; only TR-025..TR-030 human events may route S11.

invariants.statement: At most one active Loop binds exactly one locked REQ version.
REQ binding authorizes one human-locked REQ without a separate /goal; Claude /loop only schedules Wake-up prompts.
Loop automation never modifies or locks a REQ.
UI-impacting planning cannot reach contracts without the UI Design Package Gate.
Only jointly verified exact contract and task versions lock for execution.
Agent phase one is read-only and phase two activation is explicit.
Delivery, QA, and E2E Browser work uses complete single-responsibility team manifests.
Every blocking Finding maps to exactly one current InvestigationCase or an explicit duplicate, no-change, specification, or REQ disposition before S8 exits; a per-Finding BUG is not required.
S8 consumes the sealed ObservationBatch encounter and raw evidence; symptom re-reproduction is not a default investigation prerequisite.
S9 repair activation requires a current approved RepairContract; canonical BUG records are compatibility projections and cannot authorize repair.
An approved RepairContract covers every source Finding with causal, invariant and detection-gap assertions; repair invalidates affected evidence and targeted checks never replace the complete review.
A clean round uses current evidence from one complete round and has no unresolved blocking InvestigationCase or approved RepairContract.
ACC and release audit require a valid clean round.
Loop automation stops at awaiting_human_release, which is a human control gateway routable only by constrained human events; it is not a terminal state.
Squash merge and formal release require external human approval.
Runtime recovery restores state, phase and entity checkpoints without chat history.

Documentation fact: the compiled Go registry is the superset of the transition references declared here — 59 guards / 48 actions are registered (transition.GuardNames / transition.ActionNames) while this file's 81 transition declarations reference 58 unique guards / 33 unique actions. Registry >= definition is the invariant: every identifier referenced here MUST exist in the registry (LoadCatalog fail-closed check), but registry entries may exist without a declared consumer. Do not treat the count difference as documentation drift.
